desc: Creates a skill from markdown instructions, or turns an existing canvas the caller owns into a skill.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

display_name.desc: Human-readable label. Max 255 characters; not unique.

instructions.desc: Markdown body of the skill. Send exactly one of `instructions` or `canvas_id`.

canvas_id.desc: Canvas the caller owns to turn into a skill. Send exactly one of `instructions` or `canvas_id`.

description.desc: When Slackbot should use the skill. Max 400 characters.

example_prompt.desc: Max 200 characters. May contain `{skill}`, which becomes the skill mention.

mcp_servers.desc: Apps the skill needs, capped at the caller's MCP server limit. Declaring an app doesn't grant access to it.

items.desc: An app the skill needs. App servers use `app_id` and `server_id`, Salesforce servers use `permission_namespace`, and built-in servers use `service_type` alone.

service_type.desc: The server's service type: `app` for an app's MCP server, `salesforce`, or a built-in service type.

app_id.desc: App ID. Present for app servers (`service_type` is `app`).

server_id.desc: ID of the app's MCP server. Present for app servers (`service_type` is `app`).

permission_namespace.desc: Permission namespace. Present for Salesforce servers (`service_type` is `salesforce`).

id.desc: Skill ID: a canvas file ID for canvas skills, or a `builtin:` reference for built-in skills.

name.desc: Reserved for a future machine-readable skill name. Always null.

description.desc: When Slackbot should use the skill.

anyOf.desc: Enumerates the categories available for organizing AI skills.

example_prompt.desc: Example prompt. `{skill}` stands for the skill mention.

instructions.desc: Markdown instructions. Only returned by slackbot.skills.info; null elsewhere.

anyOf.desc: Who in the workspace can view and share this skill. Derived from the highest ORG/WORKSPACE-level access grant on the underlying skill canvas: `invite_only` when no such grant exists (only the creator and explicitly invited members), `anyone_can_view` when a read or comment grant exists, `anyone_can_edit` when a write grant exists.

visibility.desc: Who in the organization can view the skill. Null for built-in skills.

is_official.desc: Whether the skill is published to the organization's catalog.

access.desc: The caller's effective access to the skill. For canvas skills, the caller's access to the canvas, as in files.info. Built-in skills are always read.

mcp_servers.desc: Apps and MCP servers the skill needs.

service_type.desc: The server's service type: "app" for an app's MCP server, "salesforce", or a built-in service type.

app_id.desc: App ID. Present for app servers.

server_id.desc: ID of the app's MCP server. Present for app servers.

permission_namespace.desc: Permission namespace. Present for Salesforce servers.

display_name.desc: The server's current name as the caller sees it, or null when the server isn't available to the caller.

is_available.desc: Whether the caller can use this server.

items.desc: An app or MCP server a skill declares it needs. Listing a server does not grant access to it; normal OAuth and server permissions still apply when the skill runs.

library_count.desc: Approximate number of people who have the skill enabled.

creator_id.desc: User ID of the skill's creator. Null for built-in skills.

date_created.desc: Unix timestamp when the skill was created.

date_updated.desc: Unix timestamp when the skill was last updated.

skill.desc: A Slackbot skill as returned by the slackbot.skills.* Web API methods. Fields with no value are null.

invalid_arguments.desc: The arguments are invalid, for example both or neither of `instructions` and `canvas_id` were sent.

canvas_not_found.desc: The canvas doesn't exist or the caller can't see it.

not_canvas_owner.desc: Only the canvas owner can turn it into a skill.

is_a_template.desc: Canvas templates can't be turned into skills.

already_a_skill.desc: The canvas is already a skill. Use `slackbot.skills.update` to change it.

invalid_category.desc: `category` isn't one of the skill categories.

too_many_mcp_servers.desc: More apps were declared than the caller can enable at once.

mcp_server_not_found.desc: One or more declared apps don't exist or aren't available to the caller. `invalid_mcp_servers` lists them.

restricted_action.desc: The caller isn't allowed to author skills.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization.

canvas_disabled_user_team.desc: Canvases are disabled for the caller's team.

free_teams_cannot_create_standalone_canv.desc: Free teams can't create standalone canvases.

canvas_editing_locked.desc: Another edit to the canvas is in progress. Retry the request.

canvas_creation_failed.desc: The skill's canvas couldn't be created.

internal_error.desc: The skill couldn't be saved. Retry the request.

skill.description: Reviews information from Slack and your calendar to suggest priorities for the day.
